problem.old_behavior: Any live stale_count > 0 or any quote_date different from trade_date failed the entire live binding.
problem.conflict: The repaired LIVE transport intentionally retains stale_count as a backward-compatible source-session-date-mismatch counter. Symbol 1516 is an officially expected inactive corporate-action case with expected_inactive_count=1 and unexpected_stale_count=0.
problem.risk: A legitimate expected-inactive symbol could fail the whole intraday action board and prevent safe downstream coverage refresh workflows.

conclusion: The stale validator is now compatible with lifecycle-aware LIVE semantics without weakening fail-closed behavior for unexpected stale data. Expected inactive rows no longer poison the entire action-board binding, while a row with no executed price remains individually non-actionable.
